samples.xml_description: Implement a data width conversion circuit that converts 8-bit data input to 16-bit data output. Clock signal used for synchronous operation. Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive. Input signal indicating the validity of the input data. 8-bit input data to be converted. Output signal indicating the validity of the output data. 16-bit output data resulting from the width conversion. Input data width. Output data width. data_out register is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal (posedge clk) or the negative edge of the reset signal (negedge rst_n). Reset condition: When the reset signal is active (negedge rst_n), the data_out register is cleared to 0. !rst_n Width conversion condition: When the input data is valid (valid_in) and the flag signal is active, the data_out register is updated by concatenating the contents of the data_lock register and the data_in register. valid_in && flag data_lock register is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal (posedge clk) or the negative edge of the reset signal (negedge rst_n). Reset condition: When the reset signal is active (negedge rst_n), the data_lock register is cleared to 0. !rst_n Width conversion condition: When the input data is valid (valid_in) and the flag signal is inactive, the data_lock register is updated with the input data. valid_in && !flag flag register is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal (posedge clk) or the negative edge of the reset signal (negedge rst_n). Reset condition: When the reset signal is active (negedge rst_n), the flag register is cleared to 0. !rst_n Width conversion condition: When the input data is valid (valid_in) and the flag signal is inactive, the flag register is updated to 1. valid_in && !flag valid_out is generated when the input data is valid (valid_in) and the flag signal is active. valid_in && flag Reset data_out register on reset. If valid_in is high and flag is high, concatenate data_lock and data_in to form data_out. If valid_in is high and flag is low, store data_in in data_lock. If valid_in is high and flag is high, set flag to low. If valid_in is low, do nothing.
